component_findings.actionability: Recertified level 3 under the current criterion: Messages normally provide enough precise information to correct the issue without requiring unrelated guesswork; suggested fixes count only when semantically reliable. Evidence basis: Reviewed Java compiler/runtime diagnostic behavior as exercised by adversarial programs (compile-error variants _C, runtime-error variants _R) under javac/java. | javac produces precise compile-time diagnostics with file/line/column; since JDK 14+ helpful NullPointerException messages give improved runtime diagnostics. | Runtime exceptions provide full stack traces with class/method/line info by default, aiding debuggability across ADV-*_R cases (StackOverflowError for deep recursion, ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException, ClassCastException, etc. carry descriptive messages). | Checked exceptions force call-site acknowledgment of failure modes at compile time, a diagnostics-relevant design property, though it can add boilerplate. | Weaknesses: type erasure means some generic-related mistakes surface only as runtime ClassCastException rather than compile-time errors; unchecked exception misuse paths are not enforced by the compiler.

component_findings.abstraction_reuse: Recertified level 4 under the current criterion: Functions, modules/types and generic/polymorphic abstraction support reusable composition across ordinary programs. Evidence basis: Qualitative review of Java language feature set against template micro/adversarial programs (java/micro mb00-mb11, java/adversarial ADV-01..ADV-26) covering numeric overflow, mutation-during-iteration, recursion depth, generics, collections. | Java offers a mature generics system (type erasure limits reification), a large standard collections/streams API, lambdas, records, sealed classes, and pattern matching (switch expressions, instanceof patterns) in recent LTS releases. | Expressiveness reduced by verbosity: checked exceptions require explicit throws/catch boilerplate, no native tuples, no algebraic data type sugar beyond sealed interfaces plus records, no first-class union types. | Concurrency primitives (java.util.concurrent, virtual threads) are expressive but require explicit API usage rather than language-level async syntax. | ADV-15 shows ArrayList mutation during for-each iteration behaves per iterator contract; ADV-01_C shows narrowing long-to-int casts silently truncate per spec, requiring explicit casts rather than range-checked conversions.
